definitions.gloss: to pass out from drinking; to drink oneself unconscious
definitions.explanation: To become so intoxicated from alcohol that one collapses or falls asleep. Implies drinking to excess beyond the point of functioning.

examples.japanese: ⟦{友人|ゆうじん}→友人：03649_yuujin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{酔|よ}い{潰|つぶ}れた。
⟦{飲|の}みすぎ→飲みすぎ：22059_nomisugi⟧て{酔|よ}い{潰|つぶ}れてしまった。
examples.english: I drank too much and passed out.

examples.japanese: ⟦{忘年会|ぼうねんかい}→忘年会：15800_bounenkai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{酔|よ}い{潰|つぶ}れた⟦{同僚|どうりょう}→同僚：01023_douryou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦タクシー→タクシー：00816_takushii⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{乗|の}せて→乗せる：01972_noseru⟧⟦{家|いえ}→家：00612_ie⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{送|おく}った→送る：00742_okuru⟧。
examples.english: I put my colleague, who had passed out drunk at the year-end party, in a taxi and sent him home.

notes:
{酔|よ}い{潰|つぶ}れる is a compound verb combining ⟦{酔|よ}う→酔う：14437_you⟧ (to get drunk) and ⟦{潰|つぶ}れる→潰れる：04249_tsubureru⟧ (to collapse, to be crushed). It is an intransitive ichidan verb.

ASPECT (ている):
{酔|よ}い{潰|つぶ}れて⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧ describes the resulting state of being passed out drunk.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {酔|よ}い{潰|つぶ}れて⟦{寝|ね}る→寝る：00470_neru⟧ (to pass out and fall asleep)
- {酔|よ}い{潰|つぶ}れて⟦{動|うご}けない→動く：00904_ugoku⟧ (to be too drunk to move)

RELATED WORDS:
Compare with ⟦{泥酔|でいすい}→泥酔：14732_deisui⟧ (dead drunk — more formal, describes the state), and {酔|よ}いつぶす (transitive — to make someone pass out drunk).
